summary: Trafalgar International filed an 8-K on October 12, 2026, reporting board approval of Amended and Restated Articles of Incorporation that modify authorized capital stock and the rights, preferences, and privileges of its Series A and Series B Preferred Stock, effective upon filing with the Florida Department of State. The board authorized a Preliminary Information Statement on Schedule 14C because shareholders already approved the actions by written consent in lieu of a meeting; no proxies are being solicited and no shareholder meeting will be held. This is a routine charter amendment and consent solicitation, not a special situation; no deal terms, advisor, or premium are stated.
